title: Watch the winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE, The Gifted.
gist: Google, with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners, named Jeff Synthesized's The Gifted the winner of the Future Vision XPRIZE (2,500+ entries) for hopeful, technology-enabled films; the solo-developed project gets $100,000 plus $2.5M in feature funding and will be developed via Google's 100 ZEROS initiative.

insights.claim: Google partnered with XPRIZE and Range Media Partners to launch the Future Vision XPRIZE, a global competition for films envisioning a hopeful, technology-enabled future.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Shows Google using cultural/media sponsorship to shape public narratives around AI and technology.
insights.quote: a global competition calling for films that envision a hopeful, technology-enabled future
insights.locator: Earlier this year, we partnered with XPRIZE

insights.claim: Independent filmmaker Jeff Synthesized won the Future Vision XPRIZE grand prize in Los Angeles for The Gifted, chosen from more than 2,500 entries worldwide.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Over 2,500 entries signals meaningful creator engagement with optimistic tech storytelling.
insights.quote: Chosen from more than 2,500 entries worldwide

insights.claim: The solo-developed winning project receives $100,000 plus $2.5 million in feature production funding.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: A solo-developed project earning feature funding hints at lowered production barriers for independent creators.
insights.quote: the solo-developed project receives $100,000 alongside $2.5 million in feature production funding

insights.claim: The Gifted depicts an 11-year-old boy recreating his late mother's voice and essence with code, which then quietly cares for his whole community through the town's networks.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Positions AI voice/persona recreation as a benevolent, community-serving technology rather than a threat.
insights.quote: recreates his late mother’s voice and essence out of love and code
insights.locator: Inspired by a deeply personal story

insights.claim: The winning filmmaker's stated belief is that technology's greatest promise lies in empathy and human connection, a framing Google is elevating through the prize.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Big Tech is investing in emotionally positive AI narratives, relevant to public sentiment and adoption risk.
insights.quote: technology’s greatest promise lies in empathy and human connection
insights.locator: Inspired by a deeply personal story

insights.claim: Through its 100 ZEROS initiative, Google is partnering with Range Media Partners to bring The Gifted to the big screen.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Google is extending into Hollywood film development as a brand and narrative channel for its technology.
insights.quote: Through Google’s 100 ZEROS initiative, we are partnering with Range Media Partners
